items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Now Thaddeus who was in Chicago and our trumpet player, was playing in the band.

ctx.x: Elmer Crumley - he's a great trombone player.

Right... He left us to join the Blanche Calloway but he left us to go, as I told you, to play Villa King (Denise,) right? O.K. Now Thaddeus who was in Chicago and our trumpet player, was playing in the band. Bill Owens had the band at the Cloverleaf Club in Omaha, Nebraska, but we had 9 leaders and each time they changed leadership whoever had the band - if a guy came in and said, "Milt, I want you to play in my club. Can you get a band together?" "Sure." So what you did was come in the band room and say, "Well,…
Now what band was it? You were in this band?
